title: Archipelago at Strait of Freedom
safeHtml:
Archipelago at Strait of Freedom is the coined term for a total of 9 islands between TriPaw Peninsula and Twenty-Second Continent. It belongs to Jupiter District.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 List of Islands
  • 3 Transport
    • 3.1 Nazca Railway
    • 3.2 Ferry
    • 3.3 Routes
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

This archipelago is located between Twenty-Second and Jupiter, and is to the south of West Metropolis Archipelago (WMA). Similar to the WMA and the Internal Sea Archipelago, the Regulations for Highly Permitted Island Development also apply for the islands in here.

List of Islands[]

  • Joyhill Island
  • Sandshore Island
  • Dove Island
  • Top Island
  • Shell Island
  • Chain Isle
  • Brokenplate Isle
  • Northsand Isle
  • Stroke Isle (N/S)

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

While Nazca Railway has yet to set up any stations, according to Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition,

  • Kinight Line and Oasis Bay Line will pass through Joyhill Island and Sandshore Island,
  • Echo Line will pass through Joyhill Island.

Ferry[]

While boats can be used to access the Archipelago at Strait of Freedom, no piers have been set up as of yet.

N/A

title: Arctic Sea
safeHtml:
Arctic Sea is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central North Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-02.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Housing
    • 2.1 Public Housing
    • 2.2 Home Ownership Scheme
    • 2.3 Private Sector Participation Scheme
    • 2.4 Private Housing
  • 3 Transport
    • 3.1 Nazca Railway
    • 3.2 Major Roads
  • 4 Citations and References

History[]

The name of this Sub-District originates from Nazca Railway. The Namesake of this District originates from the Snowy Backdrop that the vicinity of this Station has provided, which also resembles a white Ocean.

At the time of the completion of Arctic Sea Station in 2020, Arcgo Line and Charlie Line was already reserved in this Station, and when Glacier Express is also considered, that station had plans to feature four lines. This made Arctic Sea the immediate choice to become the core area of the entire Asylum District, complete with commercial buildings, large Shopping Malls, Topside Developments and even Administrative Facilities. However, subsequent redevelopment and personnel changes have caused all commercial and administrative facilities to relocate to Brighton Hall. With the exception of Arctic Sea Hospital, which remained unaffected despite changes in plans, all shopping malls and their corresponding Topside Developments have been downsized.

It should be noted that Kam Leung Estate, despite being located in the Melody Sub-District, is administered by this Sub-District, and can be seen as an Exclave of this Sub-District within the Melody Sub-District.

Arctic Sea Station is a station on Glacier Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Asylum. This station will serve Glacier Express, Arcgo Line and Charlie Line in the future, and passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 2914, Line 2914P, Line 2951 (Arctic Sea Stop).

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Frigid Depths.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Gleams Between the Rails".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Frigid Depths 01:35
Moon Over the Frozen Abyss 02:10

Fun Facts[]

  • While this station was originally planned to have Island Platforms, it ultimately became a station with Stacked Side Platforms. In fact, this station has the most side platforms in a stack.
  • This station and Barode Cave Station are Sister Stations in terms of design.
  • This station uses White Wool as the sole Building Material.
  • This station is located at approximately one kilometer to the east of a Village, and a path has been constructed between this station and that village.
  • This station has a very narrow Station Control Room.[2]

Future Development[]

  • Once Glacier Express is established, and Arcgo Line and Charlie Line extends to this station, this station will become a Checkpoint.

History[]

  • November 29 2020: This Station began construction.[3]
  • December 1 2020: This station completed construction.[4]
  • December 2 2020: This station began services alongside Glacier Line, but Glacier Express, Arcgo Line and Charlie Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • March 9 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • November 1 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]
  • December 1 2024: This station is chosen as the venue for the December 2024 monthly calender.[6]

title: Area Station
safeHtml:
Area Station is a Station Class in Los Sengas. It is a class below Checkpoints, and is followed by Light Stations.

List of Stations[]

Currently, almost all stations located in Los Sengas, including NR, KR, PT and other Co-op Railways stations belong to this class, except for the following:

  • Metropolis Terminal
  • Centopia
  • Intus Occident Gateway
  • Intus Orient Gateway
  • Intus Aquilo Gateway
  • Intus Austrum Gateway
  • Fall Point Gateway
  • Summer Point Gateway (This gateway involves Nazca Railway and Nawis Railway lines at the same time.)
  • Winter Point Gateway
  • Spring Point Gateway
  • West Shoal Checkpoint
  • Flask East Checkpoint
  • Rover Down Checkpoint
  • Edward Island Checkpoint
  • Katadelphia North Checkpoint (This checkpoint involves Nazca Railway and Katadelphia Railway lines at the same time.)
  • Grand Squirrel Checkpoint (This checkpoint only involves Peckern Transit lines.)
  • Nail Bight Checkpoint
  • Tat Stone Hill Checkpoint
  • Europa Checkpoint
  • Sand Martin Checkpoint
  • Le Monde Checkpoint

Among the stations above, Edward Island, Tat Stone Hill, Le Monde, Flask East and West Shoal were formerly Area Stations, but became Checkpoints due to the increase in number of lines served.

Description []

ARIES Line will be one of the Hub Railway lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

This line is represented by Teal on the Nazca Railway Route Map.

History[]

Line Characteristics[]

  • This line will be the first Hub Railway line in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • Hence, this line may be Hub Railway Line 1.

Fun Facts[]

  • The color scheme of this line alludes to Airport Express of Mass Transit Railway.
  • While this line has yet to be established, reserved structure for this line is seen starting from the northwest of Samenta Station. It then proceeds to pass the north of Katadelphia North Checkpoint and proceeds to the east before turning north, where it begins running parallel with Origin Line and Fox Line tracks to the south of Station of Friendship. This reserved structure ends at Banyan Station. It is also known that this line will serve Metropolis Terminal Phase VIII[1] and Sand Martin Checkpoint.[2]

Rolling Stock[]

ARIES Line will use H-stock throughout.

All ARIES Line Stations will be equipped with Platform Screen Doors and Platform Gates.

Armor Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Railway
    • 2.2 Road
  • 3 Citations and References

Location[]

Armor Island is located at the southwest of Elevate Island, the northwest of Belt island and the northeast of Shell Island.

Transport[]

Railway[]

While Interisland Line originally had plans to set up Armor Island Station on this island, as the route involved too many detours and had conflicts with Nazca Ferry routes, the plans were ultimately scrapped. Moreover, the former Armor Island Light Rail had been demolished due to island regeneration.

Road[]

This island used to be connected to Elevate Island by land, but the road connection was cut off due to slow island development.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the last station to undergo expansion in 2022.
  • Black Tea Lake Station shares many similarities with this station with the regards that both stations are situated on the tip of a newly discovered continent, and both stations involve the use of red and black building materials. However, at the moment, Black Tea Lake Station does not belong to any district.
  • An intersection resembling the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge is seen to the northwest of this station, with the full lenght of both intersections being half a kilometer long.[2]
  • Contrary to popular belief, the color scheme of this station is taken in order to allude to a friend of the Railway Builder whose nickname is Arrow.[3] Moreover, the wood of this station alludes to the fact that this station is situated in a rural area in a fashion similar to Lower Shack Station.
  • This Station is Sister Stations with Hillfield Station, but unlike in Hillfield Station, the Cometsilk Line Orientation of the Concourse uses the Full Length.
  • The Phoenix Line Platforms of this Station was served by Delta Line prior to the Phoenix Line extension to this station.[4] The arrangement is made due to the fact that, as Phoenix Line have a denser time schedule than Delta Line trains, the Phoenix Line Platforms would ideally be set closer to the concourse than Delta Line to facilitate passenger transfer. In order to do so, the following steps are taken during the expansion of this station:[5]:
  1. Delta Line services between Nail Bight Checkpoint and this station are temporarily suspended.
  2. A new set of platforms are built beneath the then Delta Line Platforms using the existing Platform Numbers.
  3. Add a new branch of tracks for Delta Line so that it would go to the new Platforms 3, 4 instead of the Existing Platforms.
  4. Delta Line resume services between Nail Bight Checkpoint and this station.
  5. Renumber the existing platforms to Platforms 5, 6, and reconstruct this platform to serve Phoenix Line.
  6. Phoenix Line connects to the old Delta Line tunnels so that it would stop at Platforms 5, 6.
  7. Phoenix Line extends to this station.

History[]

  • January 11 2022: This Station began construction.
  • January 12 2022: The Platforms of this station have completed setting up.[6]
  • January 13 2022: This Station completed construction. At the same day, this station began services alongside Cometsilk Line, but Delta Line Platforms remain reserved.[7]
  • January 14 2022: Delta Line extends from Nail Bight Checkpoint to this station.
  • October 18 2022: Nazca Railway announced the Phoenix Line Extension plans of this station.[8]
  • October 20 2022: This Station completed expansion. During the expansion, a new set of Island Platforms are built beneath the original Delta Line Platform, where Delta Line is relocated, and the original Delta Line Platforms are handed over to Phoenix Line.
  • October 21 2022: Phoenix Line extends from Monley Coast Station to this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Extension of Flask Line to this station meant that Flask Line has Stations featuring the first seven Station Types.
  • The existance of this station was first announced at Glacier Station when it was constructed in Season 2, Episode 9.[2] However, this Station had only appeared 4 years, 5 months and 27 days after Glacier Station began construction.[3]
  • Peacean Island Station, a Station whose name represented peace, is located between two Stations that have weapons on its name, namely Gunshot Island Station and this station.
  • The color scheme of this station stems from the belief that beautiful cannons usually have black coatings on its surface and features gold in its components. Moreover, cannonballs are usually made of metal, hence the Blocks of Gold used in this station.[4]

History[]

  • June 7 2021: The Platforms of this station completed construction.[5]
  • June 9 2021: Flask Line extends from Glacier Station to Peacean Island Station through this Station.
  • April 3 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • January 22 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]
  • July 23 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

Ascentcloud Line is one of the lines in the Continuous Developmpent Phase of Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It currently has 10 stations, and is operated by Paleblue Railway. It runs between Mount Delrow and Cerulean Sea.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 History
  • 3 Districts Served
  • 4 List of Stations
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

Ascentcloud Line is a north-south oriented Railway Line that is established on July 1 2025, and Phase I completed construction on October 31 2025. This line serves West Peckern Continent which includes Festival and West Xofa. This enables passengers to and from the two districts to transfer to other railways and travel elsewhere using this line, and enhance railway transport links by providing a connection between the two districts.

Currently, this line starts at Mount Delrow Station and ends at Cerulean Sea Station, with possibilites to extend to Teraleros or the east coast of Viattosiipi.

History[]

  • June 22 2023: Studies regarding the route of Ascentcloud Line began.
  • June 28 2023: The Tender for Ascentcloud Line has been submitted, but was rejected due to the excessive number of tenders.
  • January 27 2025: After multiple corrections, the Tender forAscentcloud Line is submitted once again.
  • February 12 2025: Construction of Ascentcloud Line has been approved. At the same day, Neon Top Station completed construction and setting up of relevant systems.
  • February 23 2025: The Paleblue Railway section of Shiny River Station (Ascentcloud Line, Ascentcloud Express) completed construction, but the signage are not yet pasted, and the station is not yet open for use.
  • July 1 2025: Ascentcloud Line began operations between Neon Top Station and Chosen Surge Station. Ascentcloud Line is established.
  • July 14 2025: Manking Station began operations.
  • August 26 2025: Church Creek Station began operations.
  • August 31 2025: Mount Delrow Station began operations.
  • September 21 2025: Forest Tip Station began operations.
  • October 6 2025: Constell Ponds Station began operations.
  • October 22 2025: Hongwood Station began operations. Ascentcloud Express is established.
  • October 31 2025: Cerulean Sea Station began operations. Ascentcloud Line Phase I completed construction.

  • West Xofa

title: Asylum
safeHtml:
Asylum is one of the Main Districts in Los Sengas. It is represented by Lavender, and became District Number 29 on November 22 2020.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 History (Fictious)
  • 3 Sub-Districts
  • 4 Nearby Districts
  • 5 Routes
  • 6 Railways
    • 6.1 Nazca Railway
    • 6.2 SLT
  • 7 Gallery
  • 8 Citations and References

History[]

At the end of 2024, the current developer of Asylum has been invited back to Los Sengas to assist in its development, and obtained development rights of Asylum. At the time, there are three developers and planners within Asylum, and Arctic Sea was planned to be its town center, with development gradually radiating from its surroundings with mixed land use.

However, by the beginning of 2025, one of the three developers was suspended from the server, and with the other remaining developer being occupied with affairs from other servers, there was only one person left to develop and construct Asylum. Therefore, the decision was made to scrap the original plans and changed it in such a way that the district would resemble a Hong Kong-styled New Town in an attempt to balance out the population between West and East Los Sengas, as well as to complete the dreams of the main developer. While initial plans only expected Asylum to have a popluation of 400'000, the final population of Asylum was expanded to 2.5 million people, which includes the 300 thousand people within the Winsol expansion area. Development of Asylum is inspired by Peckern North and East New Territories of Hong Kong, in particular Tai Po District, the North District and Ma On Shan. It should also be noted that all the Sub-Districts and Place Names within Asylum are provided by the current developer to commemorate the people that he met on his musical endeavors.

In the latest incarnation, the town center of Asylum is relocated from Arctic Sea to Brighton Hall, which is also in turn the administrative center of Asylum. Subsequent Plans released by Nazca Railway has further emphasized the importance of Brighton Hall within the District. However, due to its relatively far distance from East Asylum, the were plans for Fine Woods to become the "East Capital" of Asylum in order to serve residents who live to the east of Route 3. However, due to personal reasons, Fine Woods only featured a Wet Market and a large Stadium, as well as a Performance Arena larger than Asylum City Hall.

Besides of the Town Center Relocation, some districts have also been renamed, with Stronglad East being renamed as Hawynveil, Stronglad West being renamed as Stronglad, and Blufield being renamed as Huntington. While Fine Woods had also undergone considerations of renaming, plans to rename that district was ultimately scrapped due to fierce opposition.

In response to the construction of Winter Point Gateway, as well as guaranteeing better connections between Asylum and Winsol, the developer of Asylum has intended to develop Winsol alongside Asylum and had received approval. As a result, Route 18 now extends to the east of Winsol, and has considered Winsol to the north of Route 18 part of the Asylum New Town, which would later become the Vermillion Stone, Mayfair Garden and Maritime Vista Sub-Districts.

After 7 months and 15 days, Asylum completed development on July 15 2025, and will undergo improvement works when Nazca Railway eventually reaches this district, such as adding pedestrian facilities and green infrastructure for housing estates that were completed during early stages of the development, as well as adding public houses at its border with Snowty when Nazca Railway adds stations on said boundary.

History (Fictious)[]

In the 1970's, Terracept has undergone a Civil War, and many asylum seekers have made their way to Los Sengas, casuing the population to surge from 2.3 million in the mid 70's to 3.3 million by the late 70's. On average, up to 700 people entered Los Sengas through One-way Permit or other legal means. Meanwhile, as many existing areas had scandals regarding build quality of public housing and needed reconstruction as a result, there exists a very severe shortage of housing in Los Sengas. Meanwhile, plans for the Los Sengas International and Intergalactic Transport Hub (Also known as the SITH) have been announced in the early 1980's, and with plans to build Satellite Cities to complement development of the SITH, it has been decided that large-scale development would take place in the mid-northern Ingress Continent after consultation with other local residents, which includes this district, north Winsol and southeast Snowty in order to support the large influx of asylum seekers. Meanwhile, a large CBD is also built at Winter Pointto facilitate foreign relations. By 1994, the first batch of residents have entered Asylum, and local residents also managed to settle in several of the various Public Housing Estates.

After a decade of development, Seaside Broadwalk finally began sales in 2008, and housing development within the district has slowed down. By now, half of the residents in Asylum are migrants from terracept, and among these residents, a sizable proportion of them are also affected by the Public Housing Scandal.

Description []

Asylum Line will be one of the District lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It will run across Snowty and Asylum, passing through Winsol in the process.

This route will be represented by Lavender on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and will be Line Number 25.

Districts Served (Tentative)[]

  • Snowty
  • Winsol
  • Asylum

History[]

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Start from the Northeast Peninsula of Asylum, travel south towards Winter Point Gateway before changing course to the Northwest, where it interchanges with extensions of existing lines Arcgo Line, Snowty Line, and Glacier Line at Snowty North Station. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Unknown Start from the Northeast Peninsula of Asylum, travel south towards Winter Point Gateway, where it interchanges with Ingress Line, Snowty Line and Rover Line, before turning back northwest to interchange with Arcgo Line, Coopol Line and Lingshan Line, and finally meeting Glacier Line and Glacier Express at Snowty North Station. Future projections will see it continue west. TBC

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line has yet to be established, reserved platforms for this line are seen at Glacier Line Snowty North Station, Snowty Line Nightcord and West Hill Stations, and Ingress Line, Snowty Line, Rover Line, Charlie Line, Mike Line Winter Point Gateway.

safeHtml:
August 1 is the 213th day of the year (214th in leap years) in the Gregorian Calendar.

Historical Events[]

2016[]

  • Project Nazca fourth anniversary.
  • GALAXY PLACE began operations.
  • New Judy Island Monorail Great Nazca Aquarium Station Station completed construction. New Judy Island Monorail is established.

2017[]

  • Project Nazca fifth anniversary.
  • Nazca Railway announced that all platform and exit signs would be of ImageOnMap Signs starting from Icelute Island Station.
  • Lines in Phase 2 of Co-Op Railway are announced.

2018[]

  • Project Nazca sixth anniversary.

2019[]

  • Project Nazca seventh anniversary.

2020[]

  • Project Nazca eighth anniversary.

2021[]

  • Project Nazca ninth anniversary.

2022[]

  • Project Nazca tenth anniversary.
  • Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Fosina Station.
  • StarTop Railway Cadence Line Peachem Flatland Station and Vector Bay Station completed construction. Cadence Line Phase III complete. Cadence Line completed construction.

2023[]

  • Project Nazca eleventh anniversary.

2024[]

  • Project Nazca twelfth anniversary.
  • Element Hub Transit Evillow Line, Evillow Express Arrowhead Station began operations.

2025[]

  • Project Nazca thirteenth anniversary.

2026[]

  • Project Nazca fourteenth anniversary.
  • Phantasia Metro Fuurin Line began operations between Lens Station and Barren Valley Station.
  • Phantasia Metro Fuurin Express began operations between Lens Station and High Parallel Station.

Axhead Island Station is a station on West Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Axhead Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to Axhead Light Railway Livelihood Line Axhead Island NR Station and Axhead Island NR Station (N) Stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station mainly uses elevators to traverse between the concourse between the Ground Level Concourse and the Platforms. With 16 elevators, and 8 elevators for each platform, this station has the most elevators besides of Metropolis Terminal at the time of its construction.[3]
  • Passengers enter the elevators from the sides and leave the elevators from the center. This Arrangement of Elevators alludes to HKU Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.[4]
  • The Concourse of this station has been expanded during the Upgrading Works.[5]

History[]

  • May 12 2015: This station began services.
  • April 4 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[6]
  • March 2 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[7]
  • June 22 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[8]
  • August 9 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[9]
  • April 8 2023: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.
  • April 23 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[10]
